ISSUED: April 1, 2022



   Construction Codes Requirements
   PERIODIC BOILER INSPECTION
   HIGHLIGHTS
   The Periodic Boiler Inspection includes but is not
   limited to the verification of inspection,
   examination, and testing of the following boiler
   components:
   1.    Burner controls and fuel train
   2.    Combustion chamber
   3.    Heat exchanger
   4.    Boiler control and safety devices
   5.    Piping
   6.    Ducts
   7.    Flue (chimney and/or vent)
   8.    Valves
   9.    Appliance appurtenances
   10. Power exhausters and/or draft fans



   BACKGROUND
   • Boilers can be damaged or cause damage if not maintained properly.
   • Periodic boiler inspections help keep building systems and people safe.
   • This Bulletin provides guidance regarding the inspection of boiler safety controls during periodic
        boiler inspections.

   • The periodic boiler inspection is also known as the required annual boiler inspection
   Read Buildings Bulletin 2022-006 for more details on the requirements.

   Send questions to constructioncodes@buildings.nyc.gov.
